problems.statement_en: Can we number the squares of an 8 x 8 board with the numbers 1, 2, ... , 64 so that any four squares with any of the following shapes have sum = 0 mod 4? Can we do it for the following shapes? (German Federal Republic 5) -->

problems.statement_en: If (x 1 , x 2 , ... , x n ) is a permutation of (1, 2, ... , n) we call the pair (x i , x j ) discordant if i < j and x i > x j . Let d(n, k) be the number of permutations of (1, 2, ... , n) with just k discordant pairs. Find d(n, 2) and d(n, 3). (German Federal Republic 3) -->
